title: User-declared generic struct: Signal<T> with constructor and receiver methods
notes: rfd#56 phase 1 (dekaruntime/dsc#93): struct Signal<T>, fn signal<T>(initial: T) Signal<T>, and receiver methods whose <T> binds to the receiver's type argument at the call site. One struct, two instantiations in a single program — types erase, both are plain struct values at runtime.
